Messages.Author: Alf Behrends
Messages.Body:
Primal Instincts
[aus] Strike: dodge.
[AUS] Only usable by the acting vampire after the opposing minion has
chosen his or her strike. Cancel this acting vampire's strike and
choose a new one.

Let's pretend
Vamp A is acting.
Vamp B has 1 strength damage and a .44 Magnum.
Vamp A is in combat with Vamp B.
Vamp A plays strike: combat ends.
Vamp B doesn't bother striking as he thinks
combat will end anyway.
Vamp A plays SUP Primal Instincts and wants to use
another strike(maybe poke for 1 agg).

Here are the questions:

Would it be required to ask Vamp B which strike
he uses before Vamp A can use P.I.?

If not and if Vamp B didn't declare a strike,
would he
a) use his hand strike?
b) use his Magnum?
c) could he choose?
d) anything else ...

Thanx.

Alf Behrends
VEKN Prince of Braunschweig
Germany

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Alf Behrends wrote:
> Primal Instincts
> [aus] Strike: dodge.
> [AUS] Only usable by the acting vampire after the opposing minion has
> chosen his or her strike. Cancel this acting vampire's strike and
> choose a new one.
>
> Let's pretend
> Vamp A is acting.
> Vamp B has 1 strength damage and a .44 Magnum.
> Vamp A is in combat with Vamp B.
> Vamp A plays strike: combat ends.
> Vamp B doesn't bother striking as he thinks
> combat will end anyway.
> Vamp A plays SUP Primal Instincts and wants to use
> another strike(maybe poke for 1 agg).
>
> Here are the questions:
>
> Would it be required to ask Vamp B which strike
> he uses before Vamp A can use P.I.?

Yes. You'll always chose your strike (barring Hidden Lurker et al), even
if it doesn't resolve.

> If not and if Vamp B didn't declare a strike,
> would he
> a) use his hand strike?
> b) use his Magnum?
> c) could he choose?
> d) anything else ...

If he didn't declare any strike (common, in practice) it is assumed he
chose his default strike (hands).

Flux
